name: Navamsha (D9)
purpose: To assess the 9th harmonic. Shows the true inherent strength of planets, marital happiness, and inner nature.
prerequisites: Accurate birth time (changes roughly every 13-15 minutes)
known_conflicts: Ayanamsa changes can shift planets in D9 easily

name: Dashamsha (D10)
purpose: To assess professional achievements, power, and authority.
prerequisites: Highly accurate birth time (changes roughly every 12 minutes)

name: 8 Chara Karakas
purpose: To identify soul-level roles (AK, AmK, BK, MK, PK, GK, DK) including Rahu.
calculation_requirements: Compare degrees of 7 physical planets + Rahu (measured from end of sign)
source: Sanjay Rath / P.V.R. Narasimha Rao interpretations of Jaimini Sutras
implementation: Not fully implemented (currently using 7 scheme in codebase)
known_conflicts: Fierce debate over whether Rahu should be included.

name: Shadbala
purpose: To measure the exact quantitative strength of a planet across six sources.
calculation_requirements: Sthana, Dig, Kala, Cheshta, Naisargika, Drik
source: Graha and Bhava Balas by B.V. Raman
known_conflicts: Slight variations in Drik Bala and Cheshta Bala calculation between Sripati and modern software like JHora
